  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"

  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2A)               Design a Mealy-type circuit, using D flip-flops, with one input and one output, to detect the overlapping        (4)

3A)               Derive the boolean expressions for the next state logic of a hazard-free mod-4 asynchronous pulse                (4)

  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3B)               Using negative edge triggered JK flipflops, design a decade ripple up-counter and draw its timing diagram.       (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  
3C)               Construct the excitation table for a Master-Slave D flip-flop as an asynchronous sequential circuit using the (3)

  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"
